item.trainmurdermystery.blackout.tooltip:
Turns off all lights on the train for 15 to 20 seconds
Use your Instinct [Left-Alt] to see your targets in the dark
Activates immediately upon purchase, 5 minute cooldown
item.trainmurdermystery.body_bag.tooltip:
Use on a body to bag and remove it
Single use, 5 minute cooldown
item.trainmurdermystery.crowbar.tooltip: Use on any door to permanently open it
item.trainmurdermystery.derringer.toolti:
Aim, right click and shoot
Can only shoot once, so make it count!
Bullet replenishes after a kill
item.trainmurdermystery.firecracker.tool:
Detonates 15 seconds after being placed on the ground
Can be used to simulate gunshots and lure others
item.trainmurdermystery.grenade.tooltip:
Right click to throw, explodes on impact
Good for clearing crowds, but watch out for the blast radius!
Single use, 5 minute cooldown
item.trainmurdermystery.knife.tooltip:
Hold right click and get close to your victim
1 minute cooldown after a kill
Attack knocks back a player (no cooldown)
item.trainmurdermystery.lockpick.tooltip:
Use on any locked door to open it (no cooldown)
Sneak and use on a door to jam it for 1 minute (3 minute cooldown)
item.trainmurdermystery.note.tooltip:
Write a message and pin it for others to see
Sneak use to write a message, then use on wall or floor to place
Invisible when held
item.trainmurdermystery.poison_vial.tool: Sneak into food or drink to poison the next person who takes it
item.trainmurdermystery.psycho_mode.tool:
"Do you like hurting other people?"
Hides your identity and lets you go on a rampage with a bat for 30 seconds
Full swing with bat kills, and cannot be unselected during ability
Activates immediately upon purchase, 5 minute cooldown
item.trainmurdermystery.revolver.tooltip:
Aim, right click and shoot
Drops directly if you kill a civilian
item.trainmurdermystery.scorpion.tooltip: Sneak into a bed to poison the next person who tries to rest

announcement.role.amnesiac: Can eat others' bodies, becoming the deceased's identity after eating. Win condition is same as the deceased.
announcement.role.arsonist:
Starts with gasoline and lighter. Can see orange outline after dousing.
Exclusive Item - Gasoline: Right click on others to douse them.
Exclusive Item - Lighter: Right click to ignite doused players. If ignited players are less than 1/6 of total players, you die too.
announcement.role.necromancer:
Exclusive Skill: When killer team count is less than initial killer count, can revive dead players as random killer role.
Reviving plays totem sound and global announcement.
announcement.role.avaricious: Every minute, steals coins from nearby players. Each player can provide 30 coins. Starts with only 50 coins.
